scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme for Goan Diaspora
other_conditions: Applicant must be a new or existing business unit
Operations must be based in Goa
Applicant must be one of the following entity types: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar
The unit must have operated from the intended office space for more than one year
The company or firm must be registered in Goa
The CEO/Head or Majority Stakeholder(s) must be part of the Goan Diaspora
The unit must employ at least 15 people, with at least 60% being of Goan origin
Employees must remain on the company’s payroll for a minimum of one year
benefits_summary: Provides a capital investment subsidy of up to 20% on eligible investments, with additional 10% incentives for mega units, key focus areas, and Goan diaspora ownership, subject to caps based on unit size.
